shots.visual: Frame 0: I hungry ❌. Planned frame 15: reveal I am hungry ✓; highlight am. Illustrative mistake, not a real learner quote.
Correct sentence remains visible. Andrew speaks only the correct English example.
I + am + hungry. Highlight am. Explanation on screen: Trong câu này, sau I cần có am trước hungry. No general rule about every adjective.
A. I tired / B. I am tired — initially omit correctness marks. Both are visual-only. Hold for an editorial practice pause before answer.
Reveal B. I am tired ✓ only after the practice hold. No reading of the incorrect option.
Keep I am tired ✓ visible; one short repeat CTA, no extra follow/comment CTA.

storyboard.answerReveal: After full practice audio plus proposed hold; English answer and correct option begin together. Actual frame set only from verified WAV samples.
storyboard.captionPlan: Canonical full sentence cues from imported WAV sample boundaries; no invented word timestamps. Visual-only wrong answers never enter spoken captions.

creativeReview: Frame zero is readable within safe area on a phone.
V2 correct answer visible at proposed frame15; no fade from black.
Only correct standalone English examples use Andrew; Vietnamese uses NamMinh.
Wrong sentences are illustrative visual-only text, never spoken or attributed to a real learner.
The grammar explanation applies to this I/am sentence, not every adjective.
Practice hold and answer reveal give enough time to choose; measure with genuine audio.
20–35s is a target, not measured speech; no speedup/trimming to force duration.
Owner hears both variants and checks pronunciation, naturalness, pacing and usefulness.
